fr_html: M. Loder ajoute que c'est, dans une large mesure, grâce aux efforts du Baron Descamps, que les travaux du Comité ont abouti.
en_html: M. Loder added, that it was largely due to Baron Descamps' efforts that the work of the Committee had been crowned with success.
